# Gantt focus test can click Cancel while the editor opens

## Context

The hosted Dock branch [shard 13](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45048284157/job/137287960758) ran 92 cases. The Gantt `EditorFocus.spec.mjs:53` check failed because Cancel left the editor visible for five seconds. The first polls saw the opening animation class; subsequent polls saw it clear. The shard finished with one assertion failure.

## The Problem

The spec waits for the dialog to become visible. The button can move after that wait. In headless Chromium with the hosted example's data, a trusted pointer-down hit Cancel during the opening transition. After the opening flight settled, pointer-up at the same point hit a field label. Cancel received no click and the editor stayed open. A new click at the settled button closed the dialog and restored focus to the task in all three replays.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: the test asserts that the editor hands focus back to its task on Cancel and Save. `Dialog#animateShow` mounts before it finishes moving. `Component#startMountFlight` tracks that opening in the App Worker. The Desktop test uses that same lifecycle boundary before acting on a moving button. [Existing guard](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/c916b512ee17af5e78c0a27ea547348040c45c47/test/playwright/e2e/webdesktop/PhoneAndTouch.spec.mjs#L110-L121)

## The Fix

Wait for the actual editor to be mounted and visible with `mountFlight === null` before the Cancel and Save pointer interactions in `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/EditorFocus.spec.mjs`. Keep the two Escape cases and the focus assertions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The pointer-driven focus test observes the real opening-flight boundary and still verifies Cancel and Save return focus to the same task.
- [ ] Both Escape cases retain their existing inputs and assertions.
- [ ] All three cases pass repeated headless Chromium runs.

## Out of Scope

Changes to dialog animation, pointer behavior, and focus restoration runtime code.

## Related

Gantt focus behavior landed through #21710. #21853 records the same opening-flight boundary for the Desktop test. I’ll take the test fix while v14 CI is active.
